item.title: Golden Globe fleet gathers as Route du Rhum prep begins
item.description: Sixteen solo skippers have gathered in Les Sables-d’Olonne to begin final preparations for the 2026 Golden Globe Race, the only round-the-world event sailed in 1960s-era boats without modern electronics or outside assistance.

item.title: Toronto Star spotlights Shawyer’s solo round-the-world bid
item.description: A Toronto Star profile this week framed Scott Shawyer’s Vendée Globe attempt against the losses of Gerry Roufs and Derek Hatfield.
